scenario_selection.details: Displays PRESET_SCENARIOS with item, merchant, category, amount, currency, and expected policy outcomes.

senso_rag_evidence.details: Displays Senso AI ground evidence, source document title, relevance score (96.4%), and citation URL.

policy_decision.details: Displays deterministic policy engine results, policy version, decision status (APPROVED/REQUIRES_LINQ_APPROVAL/REJECTED), and minor unit integer cents.

linq_imessage_tapback_simulator.details: Displays native Linq iMessage simulator for high-value purchases requiring CFO approval, with 👍 (Approve) and 👎 (Reject) interactive tapback controls.

prava_card.details: Displays Prava Single-Use Virtual Credential card visualizer with isolated card data, limit, status (IDLE/ACTIVE/LOCKED), and session token management.

redacted_audit_log.details: Displays immutable, event-driven redacted audit trail and ledger with timestamps, event types, details, and status badges.
